title: Model Introduction Runway & Stakeholder Sprint Map
creator: Asha Patel
description: Compact, sprint-oriented checklist to coordinate cross-functional launch activities for a new model addition to the catalog. Emphasis on clear handoffs, measurable benchmark gates, release note alignment, and staged comms to internal and external stakeholders.
checklist: Pre-launch: Confirm model artifacts and licensing (PM + Legal): verify license file in model repo and attach to PRD
Pre-launch: Model performance baseline: run standard throughput/latency bench harness and push results to telemetry dashboard
Pre-launch: Eval suite: QA to create regression prompt set and expected outputs; add to evals runner
Pre-launch: Security & compliance: security team to sign off on PII risk checklist and KMS integration docs
Integration: Engineering to create model-serving PR with compatibility shim and CI smoke tests
Integration: Infra to validate Dedicated and Private deployment images and document resource profiles
Docs: DevDocs writer to draft API samples, SDK examples, and migration notes; link to code samples
Benchmarks: Quantize profile recommendations and cost-per-token estimates added to model catalog entry
Release notes: PM to draft release notes template, include breaking changes, known limits, and toggles
Launch comms: Coordinate announcement draft with Growth; prepare customer-facing one-pager and changelog entry
Rollout: Plan staged rollout via canary -> regional -> global; define thresholds for rollback
Post-launch: Monitoring: enable model-specific dashboards, set alert thresholds for latency/error rate
Post-launch: Ops playbook: add runbook steps for fallback to compatible model variants
Post-launch: Telemetry: ensure token-level cost tracking and example trace IDs are captured for first 48 hours
Feedback loop: Schedule 1-week post-launch retro with data-driven quality review and follow-up ticket list
acceptance_criteria: Model catalog entry created with artifact links, license, and quantization profile
Benchmarks uploaded and passing performance gates for targeted instance types
Docs published with at least one end-to-end SDK example and migration notes
Release notes reviewed by Legal and approved by Growth; announcement assets ready
Rollout plan documented with metric thresholds and automated rollback configured
Monitoring dashboards and alerts live; first-48h telemetry pipeline validated
